_note: Industry guidance on how loads behave and what protects them, not ABYC E-11 table values. Verify against the equipment maker's documentation. This file is the contract: the TypeScript copy (src/profiles.ts) and the Python copy (backend/app/calculators/modules.py) are both tested against it.

inverter.label: Inverter / inverter-charger
inverter.surge_note: Inverters draw large surge currents on motor/compressor start-up; use a time-delay / high-interrupt fuse (e.g. Class T or MRBF for large banks).
inverter.char: time-delay, high interrupt capacity (Class T recommended for banks able to deliver >5 kA fault current)

battery_main.label: Battery bank main / positive feed
battery_main.surge_note: The main fuse protects the conductor, not the load; it is sized to the cable ampacity.
battery_main.char: high interrupt capacity matched to the bank's prospective short-circuit current (Class T for lithium/large AGM banks; ANL/MEGA only where the AIC is adequate)

battery_charger.label: Battery charger output
battery_charger.surge_note: Charger output current is limited by the charger; size at 125 % of rated output.

alternator.label: Alternator output
alternator.surge_note: Never open an alternator output circuit while running (load-dump destroys diodes). ABYC requires overcurrent protection within 7" (178 mm) unless self-limiting; some manufacturers advise against fusing the B+ lead - follow their documentation.
alternator.char: MRBF/ANL/MEGA sized ≥125 % of rated output, or per manufacturer

dc_dc.label: DC-DC charger / converter
dc_dc.surge_note: Protect both input and output leads; input current exceeds output current when stepping voltage up.

solar.label: Solar controller (PV or battery side)
solar.surge_note: PV side: 1.25 × Isc × 1.25 (irradiance); battery side: 1.25 × controller rated output.

motor.label: Motor (windlass, thruster, pump)
motor.surge_note: Locked-rotor / inrush current is 3–6× running current; use a slow-blow fuse or thermal breaker per the motor manufacturer's rating. Windlass/thruster breakers are usually specified by the manufacturer.
motor.char: slow-blow / thermal breaker; manufacturer's rating takes precedence

capacitive.label: Capacitive / electronic load
capacitive.surge_note: Input capacitors cause a brief inrush; use time-delay characteristics.

electronics.label: Electronics / instruments
electronics.surge_note: Follow the equipment manufacturer's fuse rating; small fuses protect the wire.
